body: Never hard-wire one model where users will bring many (satl-no-hardwire). Before writing code that embodies a policy (storage drivers and their auth, key layout and IDs, auth/ACL and actor source, signing keys and KMS, scanning and content detection, delivery and events, rate limits, the HTTP error envelope in fshttp/upload/recordshttp/share, clock and randomness), list the models real apps use and make callers depend on a small interface, ours as the default, others pluggable through one typed option. A feature importing another feature's concrete type to decide something is a hard-wire. Use the Store/Disk clock and ID generator, never time.Now or rand.Text beside them. Security floors (traversal checks, expiring signatures, constant-time compares, magic-byte sniffing, SSRF guards) are not hard-wires. First confirmed example: WithURLSigner is silently ignored on drivers that presign (disk_url.go:66). Audit: the internal audit notes.
